name: Preface to the Third Edition of the Via Media (1877)
name_pt: Prefácio à Terceira Edição da Via Media (1877)
desc: Newman's long Preface of 1877 to the republished Via Media, written as a Catholic. He restates the Anglican theory of the Via Media, reviews the arguments of his Prophetical Office lectures and of the Letter to Pusey, and explains how the Church's threefold office as prophet, priest and king bears on Anglican claims, reprinting the Preface to Tract 71 and Tract 90 passages.
desc_pt: O longo Prefácio de Newman (1877) à reedição da Via Media, escrito como católico. Ele retoma a teoria anglicana da Via Media, passa em revista os argumentos das conferências sobre o Ofício Profético e da Carta a Pusey e explica como o tríplice ofício da Igreja, de profeta, sacerdote e rei, incide sobre as pretensões anglicanas.
edition: The Via Media of the Anglican Church, vol. 1, 3rd edition, Preface (London: Longmans, Green, 1877), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
note: The 1837 Lectures on the Prophetical Office of the Church that follow it (Anglican) are not in this book.
